items.title: Jins tay karne ke nizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the three sex-determination systems, block for block, with the Kitab ki ghalti box (PDF 103-105).

blocks.text: Drosophila, mammals aur zyada tar doosre vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale janwar) mein sex chromosomes ka jora aik danda numa (rod-shaped) X chromosome aur aik kunda numa (hook-shaped) Y chromosome par mushtamil hai. Maada XX aur nar XY hote hain. Drosophila mein autosomes ke 3 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora hai; insanon mein autosomes ke 22 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora.

In janwaron mein maada homogametic hai, yaani us ke sab eggs mein aik X chromosome hota hai. Nar heterogametic hai, yaani woh do qisam ke sperm banata hai: aadhe mein aik X aur aadhe mein aik Y. Agar X wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to zygote XX hoga; yeh embryo maada ke tolidi aaza (female sex organs) banata hai aur bachchi paida hoti hai. Agar Y wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to zygote XY hoga; yeh embryo nar ke tolidi aaza banata hai aur bachcha (larka) paida hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: Drosophila ka karyotype, autosome jore surmai khanon mein aur sex chromosomes gulabi khanon mein: XX (maada) aur XY (nar, kunde jaisa Y). Daen: insani karyotype, autosome jore 1 se 22 chhote hote hue surmai khanon mein, aur sex chromosomes XX (maada) aur XY (nar) gulabi khanon mein. Neeche baen key: surmai autosomes, gulabi sex chromosomes.

blocks.text: Surmai khanon mein autosomes hain jo nar aur maada mein aik jaise hain; gulabi khanon mein sex chromosomes hain. Maada mein do X (XX) aur nar mein aik X aur aik chhota kunde jaisa Y (XY). Drosophila ke 3 autosome jore aur insan ke 22.
